desc: Ideation complete: Analyzed the problem as counting paths in a grid with a rectangular hole using Inclusion-Exclusion Principle (PIE) on 4 outer rectangles.
Implement a modular arithmetic helper class or functions for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and inverse.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to $2 \cdot 10^6$ to compute binomial coefficients in $O(1)$.
Implement `Solve(W, H)` which computes $\sum_{dx=0}^W \sum_{dy=0}^H (W - dx + 1)(H - dy + 1) \binom{dx+dy}{dx} \pmod P$.
Optimize the double sum for `Solve(W, H)` to $O(W+H)$ or better.
Define the 4 main rectangles and their intersections for PIE.
Apply PIE formula and print result.
